description: This file defines a synchronization store for a NextChat application, managing state related to cloud synchronization via WebDAV and Upstash, including import/export, sync, and configuration functions.

classes.name: WebDavConfig
classes.description: Interface defining WebDAV server configuration with server URL, username, and password.

methods.name: cloudSync
methods.description: Checks if all WebDAV or Upstash config fields are populated for cloud synchronization.

methods.name: markSyncTime
methods.description: Updates the last sync time and provider in the state.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Exports current app state as a JSON backup file with timestamped filename.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Reads app state from a file, merges it with local state, and reloads the page.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a sync client based on current provider and config.

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Performs synchronization by fetching remote state, merging, and updating local state.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks the connectivity/status of the sync client.
